name: web_search
description: Browse the web using a real Chromium browser. Can search, navigate to URLs, read rendered page content (including JavaScript-heavy sites), and follow links.

manual.overview: Use web_search to find information on the internet. It uses a real browser engine (Playwright/Chromium) to search and read pages, including JavaScript-rendered content. Use for current events, documentation, or any knowledge not in your memory.
tips: Use specific search queries for better results.
Use the url parameter to read a known page directly.
Set depth > 1 to read multiple search results for comprehensive research.
For academic papers, prefer arxiv_search. For encyclopedic knowledge, prefer wikipedia.
edge_cases: Some sites block automated access — results may be incomplete.
Very large pages are truncated to avoid overwhelming context.

_note: This tool uses the existing WebBrowseTool Python handler (Playwright-backed). The JSON definition provides the biological metadata.
